{{Top|leg}}
'''Synthblast''' was a spreadable gummy-like substance, usually used in conjunction with [[Grenade/Legends|explosives]], typically to hold the explosive in a specific place that would otherwise be impossible. [[Trever Flume]] made use of synthblast during his break-in to [[Jenna Zan Arbor|Jenna Zan Arbor's]] [[Jenna Zan Arbor's apartment|apartment]], spreading it on the lock to her apartment door and sticking an [[Alpha charge|alpha-charge]] on the synthblast to blow the lock.<ref name="Master of Deception">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref>
